notes: Correction: whether (t032) is moved from the first לְ (s021) to אוֹ (s024), which now holds the discontinuous correlative pair whether ... or headed on or, and s021 joins s025 as unrepresented. Rule 14 lets a morpheme other than the connective take an opening correlative only where that morpheme is itself what the correlative says; a preposition meaning for is not what whether says, so the pair stays with the disjunction that is written. Every other unit is retained as accepted.

The law for her that beareth is divided under rules 19 and 41: the substantival article carries her that and heads on the pronoun, while the participle, as the nomen rectum of תּוֹרַת, carries the relational for together with beareth and heads on the lexeme.
Both assimilated [הַ] tokens are unrepresented because the ASV writes a male and a female indefinitely (rules 12, 29).
